def compute(chars, output):
    position = 0
    max_segment = 0
    pairs = 0
    inside = False
    while position < len(chars):
        if chars[position] == '(':
            inside = True
        elif chars[position] == ')':
            inside = False
        elif chars[position].isalpha():
            position -= 1
        if inside:
            position += 1
            while position != len(chars) and chars[position] != ')' and not chars[position].isalpha():
                position += 1
            if position == len(chars) or not chars[position].isalpha():
                continue
            position += 1
            while position != len(chars) and chars[position].isalpha():
                position += 1
            pairs += 1
        else:
            position += 1
            while position != len(chars) and chars[position] != '(' and not chars[position].isalpha():
                position += 1
            if position == len(chars) or not chars[position].isalpha():
                continue
            start_idx = position
            position += 1
            while position != len(chars) and chars[position].isalpha():
                position += 1
            max_segment = max(max_segment, position - start_idx)
    output.write(str(max_segment) + " " + str(pairs) + "\n")


def main():
    import sys
    input_lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    # The first line is ignored as per original code
    if len(input_lines) >= 2:
        line = input_lines[1]
        compute(list(line), sys.stdout)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
